title: test-integration: 28-file consistent residual failure cluster (post ISS-0630 + adp0x schema-literal fix), spanning unrelated subsystems -- includes adp09 pg_proc cross-tenant overcounting and adp10 audit-context GUC state
registered_by: ISSUE-FIXER (WF03-GH482-20260810 Step 1, incidental discovery during GH-482/ISS-0150 close-out re-measurement)
symptom: After fixing the 6-file adp02/04a/05/06/09/10 'public' vs 'tenant_default' schema-literal bug (ISS-0150 2026-08-10 pass, see src/design/iss0150-gh482-20260810-adp0x-schema-fix.md), zig build test-integration was run twice against two independently fresh, workspace-owned databases. adp02/04a/05/06 are now fully fixed (0 failures in either run). A 28-file cluster fails DETERMINISTICALLY and IDENTICALLY in both post-fix runs, each with its own distinct assertion failure spanning many unrelated subsystems -- timers, entities, RBAC, webhook outbox, OIDC onboarding, event store, EXP-601 quota, audit chain, cross-process isolation.
reproduction: docker exec <db_test_container> psql -U bpm -d postgres -c 'CREATE DATABASE bpm_fresh_probe'; BPM_DB_URL=postgres://bpm:bpm@localhost:5453/bpm_fresh_probe zig build migrate; BPM_TEST_DB_URL=postgres://bpm:bpm@localhost:5453/bpm_fresh_probe zig build test-integration -- exits 1, ~28 files fail deterministically.

two_named_examples_diagnosed_in_this_pas.root_cause: The test's pg_proc query (`SELECT proname FROM pg_proc WHERE proname IN ('bpm_audit_compute_chain_hash','bpm_audit_apply_chain_hash','bpm_audit_validate_chain')`) is NOT schema-qualified. pg_proc is a global catalog; these three functions are created once per schema by ordinary (non-GBL-prefixed) migrations, so every provisioned tenant schema carries its own copy. Verified directly: 24 matching (schema, proname) rows across public, tenant_default, and 8 distinct tenant_<uuid> schemas on one verification database, vs. the test's hardcoded expectation of exactly 3. The count is a function of how many tenant schemas other concurrently/previously-run integration tests provisioned in the same suite invocation -- inherently order- and suite-composition-sensitive.
two_named_examples_diagnosed_in_this_pas.fix_direction_not_yet_applied: Qualify with a namespace join (JOIN pg_namespace ON pronamespace = ... WHERE nspname = 'tenant_default') or use to_regprocedure('tenant_default.bpm_audit_compute_chain_hash') style qualified lookups per function, matching the search_path the test actually cares about.

two_named_examples_diagnosed_in_this_pas.root_cause: Observed failure: expected 'f' found 't' on a boolean-like column, following transaction-local set_config(..., true) GUC calls (bpm.actor_username, bpm.pipeline_run_id, bpm.audit_payload_full) that an insert trigger is expected to read. Consistent with either pool/connection reuse crossing GUC state between test bodies, or a stale row surviving from a different fixture in the same shared schema. Not yet root-caused to the specific mechanism; needs a dedicated diagnosis pass with connection-level tracing.
two_named_examples_diagnosed_in_this_pas.fix_direction_not_yet_applied: Not yet diagnosed to a specific fix; requires isolating whether the GUC is being read on the correct connection/transaction or leaking across pool.acquire() calls.

remaining_26_files: Not individually root-caused in this pass -- each has its own distinct assertion failure (see full lists in src/design/iss0150-gh482-20260810-adp0x-schema-fix.md Section 5). Not included in this issue's affected_areas; re-measure per-file in isolation before attributing any of them to a real defect.
pre_existing_evidence: All 28 files failed identically before this run's adp0x fix was applied (see scratch logs from WF03-GH482-20260810: gh482-fresh-full.log, gh482-shared-full.log, pre-dating any source change in this run other than the 6-file adp0x literal fix, which does not touch any of these 28 files).

resolution_20260810_wf03_gh649.summary: Full triage + partial fix pass across all 28 files (adp09, adp10, and the 26-file cluster). Complete, honest disposition below. adp09 is FULLY FIXED. The remaining 27 are split across: 2 already-passing (found stale in the issue's original snapshot), 1 flaky/noise, and 24 forwarded as 4 new, more precisely evidenced follow-up issues for their own WF-03 runs.

disposition_by_file.adp09_tamper_evident_audit_chain_test: FIXED. Two root causes: (1) TC-ADP-09-01's pg_proc query was unqualified by schema (fixed by joining pg_namespace); (2) a stale UUID-typed overload of bpm_audit_compute_chain_hash/bpm_audit_chain_canonical_payload survived migration 1107's incomplete DROP FUNCTION (12-arg list omitting the 13th p_trace_id param, so the DROP never matched) -- fixed via new migration 1141. TC-ADP-09-02/03/04 also needed the same session_replication_role='origin' scoping fix documented for TC-ADP-09-05 and reused from audit_chain_utf8_test.zig's ISS-0149/GH-465 precedent. TC-ADP-09-05 itself needed a ::uuid cast removed to match the canonical TEXT-typed function signature. Verified: all 4 tests pass consistently across 3+ independent full-suite and isolated runs.
disposition_by_file.adp10_agent_io_capture_audit_test: PARTIALLY FIXED, forwarded as GH-651/ISS-0646. Root cause fully identified: migration 1107 dropped the ADP-10 payload_full auto-population block when it rewrote bpm_audit_apply_chain_hash() from scratch, AND bpm_audit_build_agent_payload_full's p_resource_id parameter was never updated from UUID to TEXT alongside the rest of the resource_id-TEXT migration. Both fixed via new migration 1142, independently verified correct via direct psql against a freshly migrated database. However, the fix does not survive the full ~40-binary concurrent test-integration suite -- tenant_default's function body reverts to the pre-1142 shape under concurrent TestHarness.init() calls, a distinct, deep, pre-existing test-infrastructure race unrelated to the migration content itself. Forwarded to GH-651/ISS-0646 for dedicated investigation.
